how: Friends' picks on the Pick'em Record: each friend's Weekly Picks (picks/), week by week, which the Pick'em Record shows beside the models on every device, read only. Claude keeps this file from the files the owner sends, with node picks/tools/add.js <file> (never by hand, never by a job); node picks/tools/add.js --check holds it to its rules. season is the NFL season (a file for another season than the betting app's shows nothing). friends is a list, in the order they were first added: name is the friend's name as their file gives it (or as the owner renamed them, with node picks/tools/add.js --rename <old> <new>; aka then lists the names they went by, and a file sent under one of them lands on the same friend), and weeks holds a week for each file sent, keyed w1 to w22 (w19 to w22 are the playoffs). A week is saved_at, when the last file for it was saved, tiebreaker ({game_id, total_points} or null), and picks, keyed by the nflverse game id as betting/state.json's schedule writes it, each the team picked and when the file that picked it was saved. A pick counts only if it was saved before its game's kickoff; it is graded on the finals the models are graded on (state.json's processed), a tie counting for nobody. A week sent again replaces the friend's week, but a game already kicked off keeps the pick made before it. updated is when this file last changed.
